title: TV Tokyo — Youは何しに日本へ？(What Brought You to Japan?)
description: TV Tokyo's popular variety programme (2012–present) that follows foreigners arriving at Japanese airports, asking why they came to Japan. Segments are narrated in natural Japanese, with Japanese subtitles and occasional English from guests. Features encounters with people learning Japanese, visiting for anime conventions, seeking traditional crafts training, or exploring rural Japan.
creator: TV Tokyo
